name: quota
description: Lets Claude see your Claude subscription usage: the 5-hour session window, the weekly windows and extra-usage credits, each as used% against elapsed%, so pace is visible rather than just the raw number.

poll_interval_seconds.title: Minimum seconds between polls
poll_interval_seconds.description: The usage endpoint rate-limits per OAuth token, and every Claude Code session on this machine shares one token. All sessions poll through a single cache at most this often. Values below 60 are clamped.

report_delta_percent.title: Report threshold (percentage points)
report_delta_percent.description: After the first report of a session, inject the quota again only once some window has moved at least this many points. 0 reports on every prompt.

pace_caution_lead.title: Caution lead (percentage points)
pace_caution_lead.description: How far usage may run ahead of the window's elapsed time before the pace counts as worth noting. 90% used at 90% elapsed is fine; 90% used at 40% elapsed is not.

pace_alarm_lead.title: Alarm lead (percentage points)
pace_alarm_lead.description: Lead at which the injected context adds advice to spend the remaining budget deliberately.

spent_percent.title: Spent threshold (percent)
spent_percent.description: Usage at or above this counts as a spent window regardless of pace, and Claude is told to prefer wrapping up.

visible_alerts.title: Show alerts in the transcript
visible_alerts.description: Surface a message to you when a quota state gets worse, not only to Claude. Improvements are never announced.

wrap_up_nudge.title: Advise Claude when quota is tight
wrap_up_nudge.description: When a window is spent or badly outpacing its clock, add an instruction to prefer finishing and handing off over starting large new work.

keep_history.title: Record poll history
keep_history.description: Append each poll to history.ndjson in the plugin data directory (pruned to 30 days), so the MCP tool can report trends.

request_timeout_seconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_seconds.description: How long a poll may take before it is abandoned. A timed-out poll falls back to the last cached reading, and tells Claude that the refresh failed.

debug_log.title: Log errors
debug_log.description: Append internal errors to errors.ndjson in the plugin's data directory. Hooks stay non-blocking either way; this is the on-disk record, separate from the failure Claude is told about.
